title: uPVC Sliding Window Wheel Replacement and Alignment in HSR Layout, Bengaluru
description: At Kutbi Aluminium Glass & Hardware, we recently completed a professional uPVC sliding window wheel replacement and alignment project in HSR Layout, Bengaluru. Over time, sliding windows can develop operational issues due to worn-out rollers and shifting frames, making them difficult to slide smoothly. Our skilled technicians carefully inspected the system, replaced the damaged wheels with high-quality hardware, and expertly realigned the window to ensure seamless, quiet, and effortless movement. This restoration successfully resolved the jamming issues and improved everyday usability for the client. We take pride in delivering prompt and reliable repair services across Bengaluru.
